title: Eventhouse and KQL Database Architecture
purpose: Show ingestion, hot-cache and retained-data tiers, OneLake availability, and native or cross-engine query surfaces.
accessibleSummary: Streams enter KQL databases inside Eventhouse. Premium cache serves a hot window while standard storage retains history. Optional OneLake availability writes Delta for other Fabric engines.
longDescription: Eventhouse groups KQL databases and monitoring. Event data is ingested into retained KQL tables; caching policy keeps recent data hot independently of retention. KQL serves native real-time queries. Optional OneLake availability batches a Delta representation for Direct Lake, Spark, Warehouse, and Lakehouse.
